column1: // The four questions the host's own PhotosUI does not answer, with what it does instead and why the
// port is not asked to match it. One "name<TAB>reason" line each; run.sh compares every other line
// and fails on any difference, and fails as well if one of these four stops differing - a stated
// difference that no longer holds is a measurement that has gone stale, not a pass.
// Measured on this machine on 2026-09-30 with the host's PhotosUI framework linked into the probe
// (macOS 27.0, the SDK of the installed Command Line Tools): each of these four takes the process
// down with it, which is why cases.m asks every question in a forked child - the first version of
// this probe did not, and answered twelve questions before it died on the thirteenth.
// What both sides answered that day is in answers/host.answers and answers/port.answers, the 38
// lines each, byte for byte; `sh run.sh --recorded` holds a fresh run to them, and the counts the
// series quotes - 34 the same, 4 here - are countable in those two files. Nothing above is a claim
// without the run beside it.
// The four are not questions the port is alone answering. tests/backports/device/phpickermodel.m
// asked all four on an iPad 2 running iOS 6.1.3 on 2026-10-01 and every one of them is `ok` there
// (38 checks, 0 failures): the release takes an empty array, a nil array, the negation of nil and
// the unsupported playback style, and answers a filter to each.
// The port answers all four with a PHPickerFilter. That is not a divergence from the host's
// behaviour, because the host has none to diverge from: the question is outside what Apple's own
// implementation accepts. What the port answers is the reading of the header's word - a conjunction
// over no constraints is every media type, a nil array is read as an empty one, and a filter of an
// unsupported playback style names nothing - and facts/PhotosUI/Filters.md says which of the two
// readings is a decision.
all.ofEmpty
column2: an empty array is outside what the host's own implementation accepts; the port answers it as the header's word reads, every media type

column1: all.ofNil
column2: nil is outside what the host's own implementation accepts; the port reads it as an empty array

column1: not.ofNil
column2: nil is outside what the host's own implementation accepts; the port reads it as an empty array

column1: playbackStyle.0
column2: PHAssetPlaybackStyleUnsupported is outside what the host's own implementation accepts; the port answers the filter that names nothing
